server.name: ecommerce-unified-mcp
server.description: Unified E-Commerce & Logistics MCP Server connecting REST APIs, GraphQL, Python Plugins, and Mock microservices.
server.instructions: Use this MCP server to look up customer profiles, inspect orders, check warehouse inventory, query international country/currency data via GraphQL, calculate tiered enterprise quotes, and file customer support tickets.

tools.name: get_customer_profile
tools.description: Fetches a customer's contact details and company information by their numeric user ID.

tools.name: list_customer_orders
tools.description: Retrieves recent orders/posts associated with a specific customer ID.

customer_id.description: Customer ID whose orders should be listed

tools.name: create_support_ticket
tools.description: Creates a new customer support ticket in the backend ticketing system.

subject.description: Short summary title of the support issue

description.description: Detailed explanation of the customer's issue

tools.name: lookup_country_shipping_info
tools.description: Queries the GraphQL Country Directory for currency, capital, and language details using a 2-letter ISO country code (e.g., 'US', 'IN', 'DE', 'JP').
tools.graphql_query: query GetCountry($code: ID!) { country(code: $code) { code name native capital currency emoji languages { code name } } }

code.description: Two-letter uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'US', 'IN', 'GB')

tools.name: calculate_enterprise_quote
tools.description: Calculates a B2B order price quote including tiered customer discounts, bulk volume discounts, and regional sales tax.

unit_price.description: Base price per unit in USD

tools.name: check_warehouse_inventory
tools.description: Checks real-time stock availability and fulfillment SLA for a product SKU in a target warehouse region.

resources.name: Global Shipping & Return Policies
resources.description: Official SLA, customs, and return policy rules for AI support agents

resources.name: MCP Runtime Diagnostics
resources.description: Live runtime health and capability report generated by a Python plugin

resources.name: Dynamic Customer Profile Resource
resources.description: Live customer record fetched on-demand from the REST backend via URI template

prompts.name: investigate_customer_issue
prompts.description: Guided workflow to investigate a customer's profile, recent orders, and open a support ticket

arguments.name: issue_summary
arguments.description: Brief description of the reported problem

prompts.template:
Please investigate the issue reported by customer ID {customer_id}: '{issue_summary}'.
1. Call `get_customer_profile` with user_id={customer_id}.
2. Call `list_customer_orders` with customer_id={customer_id} to review their recent activity.
3. Summarize your findings and offer to create a support ticket using `create_support_ticket`.

prompts.name: prepare_international_quote
prompts.description: Generates an international B2B price quote with local currency context
prompts.template:
Prepare an international enterprise quote for {quantity} units of SKU '{sku}' (unit price: ${unit_price} USD) shipping to country '{country_code}':
1. Check stock via `check_warehouse_inventory`.
2. Look up destination country currency and details via `lookup_country_shipping_info` with code='{country_code}'.
3. Calculate the final pricing breakdown via `calculate_enterprise_quote` with tier='enterprise'.
